description: This file contains unit tests for the ThingsConditionalHeadersValidator class, validating its behavior in handling conditional headers for various command scenarios related to 'things' in Eclipse Ditto.

classes.name: ThingsConditionalHeadersValidatorTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that validates behaviors of the ConditionalHeadersValidator in various scenarios involving conditional headers and command categories.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that the ThingsConditionalHeadersValidatorProvider class is immutable.

methods.name: doesNotThrowExceptionsIfAllChecksSucceed
methods.description: Tests that no exception is thrown when valid conditional headers are supplied.

methods.name: doesNotThrowExceptionsIfCheckIsSkippedBecauseOfNullAndQuery
methods.description: Verifies that check is skipped for QUERY category when conditions are null.

methods.name: doesNotThrowExceptionsIfCheckIsSkippedBecauseOfNullAndDelete
methods.description: Verifies that check is skipped for DELETE category when conditions are null.

methods.name: doesNotSkipIfEntityTagIsNullAndCategoryIsModify
methods.description: Ensures that validation proceeds when entity tag is null and category is MODIFY.

methods.name: throwsThingPreconditionFailedExceptionWhenIfMatchFails
methods.description: Verifies that a precondition failed exception is thrown when if-match validation fails.

methods.name: throwsThingPreconditionFailedExceptionWhenIfNoneMatchFailsAndCategoryIsNotQuery
methods.description: Verifies exception thrown when if-none-match validation fails for non-query commands.

methods.name: throwsThingPreconditionNotModifiedExceptionWhenIfNoneMatchFailsAndCategoryIsQuery
methods.description: Verifies that a not-modified exception is thrown when if-none-match validation fails for QUERY commands.

methods.name: assertNotThrowingNotModifiedWhenSelectedFieldsContainsPolicy
methods.description: Checks that no not-modified exception is thrown when the selected fields include '_policy'.

methods.name: assertThrowingNotModifiedWhenSelectedFieldDoesNotContainPolicy
methods.description: Verifies that a not-modified exception is thrown when the selected fields do not include '_policy'.

methods.name: createRetrieveThingCommand
methods.description: Creates a mock RetrieveThing command with specific headers and selected fields for testing.

methods.name: createCommandMock
methods.description: Creates a mock Command object with specified category and headers for testing.

methods.name: assertSkipForCommandCategory
methods.description: Asserts that conditional headers are skipped for given command categories.

methods.name: assertETagHeaderInDre
methods.description: Asserts that the exception's headers include the expected entity tag.

methods.name: assertPreconditionFailed
methods.description: Asserts that a precondition failed exception is thrown with expected message and headers.

methods.name: assertNotModified
methods.description: Asserts that a not-modified exception is thrown with the expected message and headers.
